question: The radius of a sphere is 16 cm. Find its surface area.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

⇒ Surface area = 4 × π × 16²

⇒ 4 × π × 256 = 1024π

**∴ The correct answer is 1024π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 

 
 
• 
 r = 16 cm
 Surface Area = 4πr²

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (16)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 256

⇒ Surface Area = 1024π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1024π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The amount of space occupied by a sphere is given by the formula: Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Curved Surface Area of a Hemisphere

When a sphere is cut into two equal halves, the curved surface area of one half is: CSA = 2 × π × r².

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the flat circular base: TSA = 3 × π × r².
